anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex curve fitted to the anterior cranial boundary starting from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick rostrum appearing approximately 0.15 times the length of the visible head profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel junction where the melon's downward slope meets the horizontal plane of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark punctate markings visible on the pectoral fin and lower lateral flank; minor irregular notch on the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Clearly defined circular ocular region; high-intensity specular highlights along the dorsal-lateral ridge.
